description: Submit up to 10,000 of a project's own URLs to IndexNow (relayed to Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver) so they are re-crawled without waiting for the next scheduled crawl. FREE — no credits, no OAuth. Requires the project to have an IndexNow key set (PATCH /api/seo/projects/:projectId with { indexNowKey }) — the key it hosts at https://<domain>/<key>.txt. Every completed site-audit crawl also submits its own crawled URLs automatically, so this tool is for resubmitting specific URLs on demand (e.g. right after a manual publish), not the primary path. Every URL must be on the project's own domain — a mixed-host batch is rejected before any request reaches IndexNow.

urls.description: Absolute URLs to submit, all on the project's own domain.

name: submit_indexnow
